content:
Sipeed has just launched what they claim is the world’s first 10 Gbps USB 3.2 logic analyzer. The SLogic32U3 is the successor to the SLogic16U3 3.2 Gbps logic analyzer launched in 2025. The SLogic32U3 USB-C logic analyzer supports up to 32 channels via four mini HDMI connectors, 350 MHz signal bandwidth, up to 1400 MS/s per channel with four channels, or 200 MS/s per channel with 32 channels, and is offered with an optional ADC module. SLogic32U3 specifications: FPGA – Not mentioned (potentially from GOWIN) Input channels – 32 digital channels via 4x mini HDMI ports, each with 8 channels Sample rates 1400MS/s @ 4 channels 800MS/s @ 8 channels 400MS/s @ 16 channels 200MS/s @ 32 channels Digital signal bandwidth – 350 MHz Stream FIFO buffer – 2 Gbit DDR3 Capture mode – Stream (real-time readback); depth limited by PC memory/disk Signal input voltage – 0–10 V Adjustable threshold [...]
